The '''''Coruscant Sky''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class star destroyer]] which fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] with the ''Indomitable'' battle group.

==History==
This ship was waiting for orders with the rest of the battle group when the fleet commander, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and the accompanying [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] received a [[Priority Alpha]] communication ordering them to [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was moving against the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. When the three ships moved out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] around the planet, they discovered that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces had beaten them there and were jamming all communications. Using jury-rigged technologies, the Admiral set up an attack plan. The [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']] would lead them into attacking the enemy fleet while their ground forces landed on the planet. The fleet was reinforced with the arrival of the ''[[Coryx Moth]]''. Eventually, the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] ended when General Grievous fled. The ''Coruscant Sky'' survived relatively unscathed compared to the other ships.
